Questions customers ask

Where can I buy the XAG P150 MAX in Georgia?

At Premium Drones Georgia in Lagodekhi. The P150 MAX and complete kits are in stock, with prices in lari in our online shop. You can order by WhatsApp or email.

Do you offer drone spraying services?

Yes. We treat fields by drone, both spraying and spreading. Send us the area and the crop, and we will agree a date.

Where can I get P150 MAX parts and batteries?

Original P150 MAX parts, batteries and chargers are in stock in our warehouse in Georgia. See prices in the shop.

Do you train drone operators?

Yes. PDG Academy teaches drone operation and care in practice, in the field. We also do diagnostics and repairs.
